reliability_note: Contended resource pool with rebuilds for long saturation; multi-account buying is detected and all machines on the account are deleted; a missed monthly renewal ends the machine; the public-benefit district is explicitly 'no after-sales support'.
confidence_note: The offer is the operator's own announcement and a third-party review, both on a forum, not a vendor pricing page. Port-mapping count and bandwidth are quoted from the paid sibling product, which may not match the free machine. Registering an account and reading the panel would raise it to documented.

notes: The strongest Hong Kong lead in the lane and the only free NAT host in it with a stated port-mapping count: a real KVM guest with root, ten forwarded IPv4 ports, Hong Kong district 11 on CN2, permanently free with monthly renewal. Its cost is supply: 30 machines per wave, six waves so far, each gone in minutes, and the operator explicitly rebuilds machines that saturate the pool. The free wave and the 0.60 CNY public-benefit product are different products on the same order page; only the port count and 10 Mbit shaping come from the paid card and that transfer is marked reported, not measured.
